requests.prompt: Explain how a computer stores data:

paging_trace.accounting: Layer-batch shared tensor bytes; extra includes reloads and eviction of entry residents. Host waits and CUDA spans overlap; do not sum.

pager_storage.accounting: Scratch/map/CPU masters deduplicated by storage. GPU total is their union, not an additional allocation. CPU master includes its pinned storage, not a second copy.
